title: Kodocha: Sana's Stage
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sana Kurata, a cheerful sixth-grade child actress raised by her eccentric adoptive mother and a formerly homeless manager, sets out to stop Akito Hayama, the troublemaker who rules her chaotic class by blackmailing teachers. She learns Akito is neglected and blamed by his family for his mother's death, helps him reconcile with them, and the two grow from rivals to sweethearts through middle school amid showbiz pressures, family secrets and illness.
life_message: Children can face adult-sized problems with honesty, courage and loyalty, and engaging with troubled people can change them.

content.note: Akito's karate chops, boys throw a girl into a pond, a delinquent beating, a teacher hits Akito (Wikipedia); MangaUpdates Bullying.
